relevant_practice: Multiple scenarios and metrics with transparent evaluation artifacts
palo_adoption: Versioned scenario × metric matrix; inspectable requests and responses
boundary: Multi-dimensionality is established prior art; it is not our novelty

relevant_practice: Human preference and uncertainty-aware rank presentation in relevant chat tracks
palo_adoption: Blinded usability comparisons and visible uncertainty
boundary: Preference is not factual correctness. Arena's different tracks do not all share one evaluation method

relevant_practice: Distinguishes models, serving endpoints and systems; actual-token cost per task
palo_adoption: Endpoint/configuration identity and complete cost accounting
boundary: Its documented Time per Task is derived from tokens and representative speed. PALO should separately measure actual full-workflow elapsed time, including tools and failures

relevant_practice: Human-filtered tasks; separates all-agent and common mini-SWE-agent comparisons; warns that harness versions differ
palo_adoption: Fixed-harness versus optimised-system tracks, frozen tests, reproduction evidence
boundary: Software issue resolution is not business interpretation; passing code tests does not validate source meaning

relevant_practice: Grounded multi-document reasoning; raw-document and parsed-document evaluation; separate corpus for generalisation
palo_adoption: Split parser quality from reasoning; hold out document families
boundary: A close business-document comparator. Answering questions does not by itself establish a complete reviewed blueprint

relevant_practice: Multi-step business data tasks, factoid ground truth, normalised answer checks
palo_adoption: Objective checks where possible and explicit prompt/configuration disclosure
boundary: Authors found a shared ReAct prompt disadvantaged reasoning models. One universal prompt is not automatically fair; task facts and tool scaffolds must be distinguished

relevant_practice: Document parsing metrics for text, tables, formulas and reading order; versioned evaluation
palo_adoption: Component-level extraction diagnostics and scoring-version tracking
boundary: Parsing accuracy is not correct entity ownership, process logic or governance

relevant_practice: Real-world workbook tasks with multiple input variants and outcome-based checking
palo_adoption: Native workbook tests, formulas, varied data and resulting state
boundary: Spreadsheet manipulation and spreadsheet interpretation are related but distinct tasks

relevant_practice: Grounded factuality and explicit evaluation methodology, with later suite revisions
palo_adoption: Separate genuine source support from citation existence; version judge configuration
boundary: LLM judging must be calibrated to independent human decisions on our domain-specific errors

relevant_practice: Agent tasks exposed to untrusted-content attacks
palo_adoption: Measure useful task completion alongside attack effects
boundary: Refusing everything is not a successful business system; synthetic attack tests do not establish universal confidentiality

relevant_practice: Versioned tool-agent-user tasks and trajectory-based submission artifacts; the current protocol distinguishes 2.0 single-trial scoring from 1.x text repeated trials
palo_adoption: Retain trajectories and distinguish success on one attempt from reliability over attempts
boundary: Never mix benchmark generations, trial counts or retrieval conditions in one rank

relevant_practice: Frequently refreshed tasks, objective scoring and contamination-limited design
palo_adoption: Rolling cohorts, objective gold checks and explicit contamination limits
boundary: The revised title says contamination-limited. A new public corpus is not proof it was absent from training

relevant_practice: Evaluates BPMN syntactic, pragmatic, semantic quality and validity, with human experts
palo_adoption: Accepted structural alternatives and process semantics beyond syntax
boundary: Directly relevant research; do not claim that PALO introduces process-model evaluation

relevant_practice: Native Office-file fidelity and domain Q&A tracks, with atomic reference claims
palo_adoption: Native-file fidelity separation and granular source-based judgments
boundary: Recent close comparator; its paper reports a released leaderboard, but this review does not establish broad independent replication
